title: Comprehensive oral health profiling in rheumatoid arthritis
html: Evidence on the relationship between rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and oral health remains inconsistent. In this cross-sectional study, the authors compared oral health–related quality of life (OHRQoL), caries experience, salivary function, periodontal status, and risk of developing caries in adults with RA and systemically healthy control participants.
